random_suffix.why: adds random characters to a taken slug instead of -2, -3

suffix_outside_limit.why: cuts the slug to 40 and then adds the suffix, so the suffix isn't inside the 40

hard_cut.why: cuts at the character limit, splitting a word, instead of at a hyphen

exists_callback.why: takes a function that says whether a slug is in use, not the set of slugs taken
